name: South Dakota
agencyName: South Dakota Department of Public Safety, Driver Licensing Program

retake.retakeFee: Additional test fees may apply; confirm with DPS

gdl.provisionalMinAge: 14 yrs 9 mo (14 yrs 6 mo with driver education)
gdl.permitHoldingPeriod: 180 days (restricted minor's permit before restricted license)
gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 50 hours (10 at night and 10 in inclement weather)
gdl.nightCurfew: No driving 10 p.m.-6 a.m. under a restricted minor's permit unless supervised by a parent/guardian
gdl.passengerLimits: No passengers for the first 6 months; then no more than 1 passenger under 18 (family exempt)

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity, date of birth and lawful status (certified birth certificate or valid U.S. passport)
Proof of Social Security number (Social Security card or W-2)
Two proofs of South Dakota residential address (e.g. utility bill, bank statement)
Parent or legal guardian present and completed application for applicants under 18
process.realIdNotes: A REAL ID (gold star) requires one proof of identity/date of birth/lawful status, proof of Social Security number, and two proofs of South Dakota residency presented in person.
process.visionStandard: At least 20/40 in one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 15 points in 12 months or 22 points in 24 months
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane or slow down for stopped emergency, law-enforcement, tow and highway-maintenance vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: Obey the posted school-zone limit when children are present

verifyNote: Official South Dakota sources confirm the 25-question/20-correct exam format, minimum age 14, current $38 original/renewal license fee effective July 1, 2025, and the REV 2021 manual edition. School-zone limits remain locally posted rather than a single statewide number.
